The Measles Epidemic



One day, while playing in the village, one
of the children suddenly fell ill. Before 
long, all of the children in the village
were overcome by a virulent pox!

Blessings Day Celebration



Today  is the  day that the  villagers  give 
thanks to those  that guide their  fate and
for  all  the  blessings  they  enjoy  on  the
island of Isola.  There  will  be dancing  and
ceremonies, followed by a sumptuous feast!

Isola Day Celebration



Today is the day that the villagers
commemorate their successful arrival
on the island of Isola with dancing,
celebration, and feasts!

The South Wind



A powerful southerly wind has blown in
across the island. It is a hot, cruel wind
that withers the berries, scorches the crops
in the field, and damages the stored food.

A Mighty Storm



A typhoon struck the island during the night!
All of the stored food was washed away.

The Book





* finds a bundle of parchment
wrapped in cloth at the edge of the
foliage. Peeking inside, it appears to be
a book or some collection of  writings.
The title reads,`The Island of Pearls`.

Use it to mash berries.





The villagers use the hard, smooth device
to mash the berries into a thin film that
they then allow to dry into a stretchy sheet.
The children enjoy  them  greatly, but  these
fruity snacks also keep well, which improves
the villagers` agricultural efficiency.

a strong soothing effect. * has

Welcome to Virtual Villagers! 

Your little villagers landed on the shores of
a  beautiful  and  mysterious  island  called 
Isola.  Some  basic  structures,  most likely 
built  by  previous  islanders,  already exist. 
Your villagers are scared and disoriented, so
they need your help and guidance to survive 
and thrive in their new home.

The child has recovered a rare and delicious mushroom
and is sharing it with the tribe! It is just another way
for you to help your tribe to thrive.

Children can actually help out the village.
Their keen eyes can spot rare mushrooms that
others might miss. Drag a child to this mushroom.
Hurry, though, because mushrooms wilt quickly!

Welcome to the Puzzles and Milestones screen.
The island is full of puzzles and hidden secrets
waiting to be discovered. Your goal is to solve
Isola's sixteen puzzles while helping your tribe
survive.

Congratulations!  You solved  the  island's 
first puzzle! Your villagers now have plenty 
of clean water and want to celebrate this
achievement!
